title: Protocol for Dynamic Imaging of RNA in Living Cells by CRISPR-Cas13 System
protocol: Plate cells in 12-well plates at approximately 30% confluency.
Transfect dPspCas13b-FP and gRNA expressing vectors into cells.
Recover Lipofectamine 3000 Reagent and Opti-MEM medium to 25°C.
Dilute 2 μL Lipofectamine 3000 in 50 μL Opti-MEM and mix well with a pipette.
Dilute 2 μL P3000, 0.7 μg gRNA and 0.3 μg dPspCas13b-FP plasmids in 50 μL Opti-MEM and mix well with a pipette.
Dilute 4 μL Lipofectamine 3000 in 50 μL Opti-MEM and mix well.
Dilute 4 μL P3000, 0.3 μg dPspCas13b-FP, 0.7 μg gRNA (Psp), 0.3 μg dPguCas13b-FP and 0.7 μg gRNA (Pgu) plasmids in 50 μL Opti-MEM.
Mix well with a pipette.
Incubate for 15 min at 25°C.
Add diluted plasmids to diluted P3000 reagent at a 1:1 ratio.
Mix well with a pipette.
Add DNA-lipid complex dropwise and evenly into each well of the 12-well plates.
Incubate cells for 8–12 h.
Refresh the medium.
Plate cells into glass bottom dishes for microscopic observation.
Plate cells in 24-well plates at approximately 30% confluency.
Add increasing amounts of antibiotics (e.g., 0–10 μg puromycin) to duplicate wells of plated cells.
Observe the cells under a light microscope after 24 h.
Choose appropriate concentration of antibiotic for cell line used.
Transfect dCas13-FP and gRNA vectors according to steps 1–8.
Incubate cells for 8–12 h and refresh DNA-lipid containing medium.
Change the medium to fresh culture medium supplemented with antibiotic (1 μg/mL puromycin for HeLa).
Select for 24–48 h after transfection.
Collect the cells and passage into glass bottom dishes for microscopic observation.
Wash cells with DPBS after 24 h transfection or antibiotic selection.
Transfer cells into 35 mm No.1.5 glass-bottomed dishes at 50%-70% confluency.
Exchange the medium with fresh FluoroBriteTM DMEM containing 10% FBS when cell confluence reaches 80%-100%.
Place cells back in the incubator for 1 hour before observation by microscope.
Equilibrate the microscope to 37°C and 5% CO2.
Align cameras prior to image acquisition, if necessary, using a multicolor calibration slide.
Identify suitable cells for imaging using dPspCas13b-FP channel.
Image cells in the dPspCas13b-FP channel using suitable parameters according to each used microscope of application.
Set 50%T, 0.2 second exposure time, and a 0.2 μm z-step on DeltaVision Elite imaging system.
Use deconvolution plugin with softWoRx 6.5 for image processing based on the used microscope.
Critical: Different FP expression and distribution patterns in cells can be observed under microscopic observation.
Note that dPspCas13b-EGFP usually aggregates in the nucleolus with gNC (guide non-targeting control).
Observe that off-target gRNA leads to an even redistribution of dPspCas13b-EGFP in the nucleus.
Produce reliable NEAT1 (paraspeckle) signals when effectual gRNA targets NEAT1.
